summary: Urban Terror is a freeware tactical multiplayer FPS that began as a Quake III Arena total conversion and later became a standalone ioquake3-based game.

entries.title: Urban Terror
entries.definitive_edition: Standalone Urban Terror 4.x client with server/map/mode state documented

emulation.notes: Native desktop client; multiplayer preservation depends on servers.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Documented standalone client connected to a recorded server/map/mode state

primary.version: Standalone Urban Terror 4.x client with server state documented
primary.why: Urban Terror is multiplayer and service/community dependent. The standalone client is the practical baseline, but archive fidelity depends on exact client, server, map, mode, and asset/license state.
primary.how_to_play: Use a documented standalone Urban Terror client. Record client/version, OS, server, map, mode, team, loadout, player/bot count, mods, punkbuster/anti-cheat state if relevant, and whether Quake III mod-era files or Urban Terror HD were excluded.

secondary.platform: Quake III Arena total-conversion versions / Urban Terror HD
secondary.exclusive_content: Earlier mod lineage and later remake-development branch
secondary.why: They are not the standalone 4.x baseline.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record client/server/map/mode and do not merge with Urban Terror HD/remake work.
